text_block_list.text:
Waha! This Umatokker is insane~~☆ Going 
viral in seconds is just unreal!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is it this late already~? I just 
can't stop scrolling, though.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Morning training's early tomorrow, but... 
...Eh, who cares!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I'm a genius, after all~☆ It'll work out 
somehow! Totally fine, totally fine♪"

Without thinking much of it, Fusaichi 
Pandora ended up staying up late...
